subtopic: Automated Rollback Triggers based on Prometheus Metrics
question_text: [CI/CD Pipelines & Automated Release Strategies - Q14] In a Canary deployment orchestrated with Flagger and Prometheus, what metric pattern automatically aborts the canary and rolls back to primary?

options.text: Canary HTTP request 5xx error rate exceeding 1% or p99 latency exceeding threshold over a 5-minute sampling interval
Cluster ingress certificate expiring in 30 days

answer_explanation: Canary deployment controllers monitor metrics (HTTP error rate, latency percentiles). If thresholds fail the SLA, traffic shifting immediately halts and routes 100% back to stable primary.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: A. Rationale: Canary deployment controllers monitor metrics (HTTP error rate, latency percentiles). If thresholds fail the SLA, traffic shifting immediately halts and routes 100% back to stable primary.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
